mission: Ingest all publicly available videos from the verified Kamilah Stevenson XRP/markets YouTube channel into Barrot's source database; extract timestamped claims and forecasts; cross-corroborate before using as predictive features.

identity_evidence: The June 11, 2026 iHeart / XRP Podcast interview identifies the guest as Dr. Kamilah Stevenson; the guest self-identifies her YouTube display name as Doctor Camilla Stevenson and warns that fake pages exist.
The first-party learn.kamilahstevenson.com site identifies its owner as Dr. Kamilah Stevenson, also known as The Wealth Doctor.
Vling and Scrumball third-party directories identify channel ID UCqUPJMQdkCN6lsLVDnichPA as Kamilah Stevenson; subscriber/video counts differ and do not prove ownership.
OracleCheck links a separate candidate handle @drkamilahstevenson and tracks seven dated market-call videos; the exact relation between that handle and UCqUPJMQdkCN6lsLVDnichPA remains unresolved.
Three Glasp transcript-indexed videos self-introduce as Camila Stevenson; these corroborate person attribution but are not a first-party channel-ID cross-link.
caveats: Person identity is confirmed; the canonical YouTube channel ID and exact handle are not yet first-party cross-linked.
The interview explicitly warns about fake pages; do not merge accounts by name, spelling, subscriber count or ticker focus alone.
Third-party channel analytics report inconsistent subscriber and video counts; do not use those counts as canonical.
The candidate channel ID UCqUPJMQdkCN6lsLVDnichPA and candidate handle @drkamilahstevenson may be the same channel, but that relation remains unresolved.
Do not conflate the separate unverified @KamilahStevensonXrpStocks channel.

ingestion_policy.content_access: Public metadata and publicly available transcripts only; respect platform terms and access controls.
ingestion_policy.transcript_policy: Store transcript or authorized transcript reference where permitted; preserve timestamps and transcript hash; if unavailable, record unavailable scope rather than fabricate.
ingestion_policy.prediction_policy: Extract each explicit prediction with original publication cutoff, target, direction, horizon, probability/confidence if stated, assumptions, and later outcome. Do not infer an unstated probability.
ingestion_policy.evidence_policy: Creator statements are claims, not ground truth. Independently corroborate with primary filings, official statements, market data, on-chain data, regulatory records, and independent sources.
ingestion_policy.forecasting_policy: Never use a video published after the forecast cutoff as a feature for that forecast. Prevent look-ahead and survivorship leakage.
ingestion_policy.financial_safety: Research and shadow evaluation only; no trading instruction or live order execution.

cross_corroboration_findings.claim: Confidential Transfers could improve institutional suitability by shielding MPT balances and transfer amounts while retaining cryptographic verification and optional auditor disclosure.
corroborated_details: The specification describes confidential transfers for Multi-Purpose Tokens using EC-ElGamal and zero-knowledge proofs.
The design preserves supply/accounting invariants and includes optional auditor encryption.
Feature availability and amendment activation must be checked separately from the existence of a final specification.
counterpoints: Technical capability does not prove banks have deployed it or that it increases demand for XRP as an asset.
The documented feature applies to MPT balances/transfers; it should not be generalized to every XRP payment or every XRPL transaction type.
The known-amendments page lists ConfidentialTransfer with default vote No in the latest stable release; activation status must be checked at each data cutoff.
cross_corroboration_findings.prediction_use: Do not encode as bullish price signal without independent evidence of activation, production use, measurable flows, and market response.

cross_corroboration_findings.claim: Sponsored Fees and Reserves may let an end user transact without personally holding XRP.
corroborated_details: The official documentation describes sponsors paying fees and reserve requirements for sponsees.
Sponsorship does not transfer XRP to the sponsee; the sponsor retains the XRP used to back reserves.
An official September 21, 2026 vulnerability report states the Sponsor amendment had not been activated on Mainnet at that report date and would wait for the fix in xrpld v3.4.0.
counterpoints: Do not describe the feature as live on Mainnet without a fresh official amendment-status check.
Lower onboarding friction could increase XRPL activity without proportionally increasing spot XRP demand.
The reserve sponsorship model itself has operational/security constraints and was subject to a disclosed Devnet vulnerability.
cross_corroboration_findings.prediction_use: Track amendment status, sponsor usage, new active accounts, fee/reserve sponsorship volumes, and market liquidity separately; no direct bullish inference.
